caption:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has officially become the deadliest in the country's history.

Government data now confirms at least 2,325 people have died from the virus. This grim milestone surpasses the total fatalities recorded during the major 2018 to 2020 outbreak.
